cases.resolution: Group all origins by canonical digest algorithm plus bytes, preserve unchanged sets and check every changed attribution. Reject unencodable disclosed knowledge/decision text before successful cell, envelope, frame or capsule identities can collapse to an empty encoding. The real retained activity producer now supplies a private verified origin projection only after native custody/model replay. The explicit producer-origins-v1 wire carries every anchor coordinate, producer, typed cell and full ordered eight-role revision closure; public claims are checked against independently verified native observations.
cases.remaining: Extend authenticated producer origins to other producer families and effect consumers, preserve cross-import laboratory trust, and negotiate agent-session wire contracts. This explicit local report does not establish physical scene authenticity, future custody or effect permission.

cases.finding: Sequential numeric receipts admitted another hypothesis and did not identify exact evidence, predecessor history or all state after oversized reset text.
cases.resolution: Refuse foreign hypotheses, preserve complete bounded evidence/state/history commitments, add a bounded lifetime source-once numerical profile, and expose explicit supervisor modes. Exact raw sensor, class label and unbinned detector score remain immutable per consumed source. Resets preserve source inventory and refused steps or runs export no successful prefix. The actual five-test supervisor E2E target now passes on the native runtime. Inspection confirmed retained supervision already deduplicates its cumulative observation set; layering repeated sequential updates onto that cumulative computation would double-count it and was not added.
cases.remaining: Qualify calibration and test-supermartingale assumptions, authenticate physical source identity and temporal dependence, and retain complete source/dependence explanations. Concurrent main work supplies restart checkpoints; it is preserved rather than duplicated here.

cases.finding: Native cross-session clock validation had no operator input/report path or retained multi-camera motion consumer.
cases.resolution: Expose strict frozen-session CLI validation and a shared original-query replay owner. The retained-motion v2 adapter independently pins the original query, replays every native candidate under the parent work account, binds actual rig/image geometry and exact retained source/clock generations, and maps full original capture intervals using every candidate before native temporal association. Currently adopted temporal reconstruction now checks exact retained calibration/sensor/geometry/image scope and all full mapped source intervals before JPEG decode. Retained handoffs consume the opaque source-owner projection and map every observation with all clock candidates into a separate native solver query. Original local-time source records remain unchanged; publication retains the deployment guard and deadline. The standalone command now supplies the absolute root required by its unchanged read-only context.
cases.remaining: Authenticate the original clock-query observation custody and associations, qualify field calibration and source timing, and separately authorize physical clock activation. The handoff clock profile is explicitly two-stream; static atlas admission continues to reject temporal reconstructions.
